Vision

Modernacy aims to provide creative, unique, and functional solutions to clients through innovative designs at every scale. Specializing in residential and small scale commercial projects, our services include site planning, architectural design, interiors, and graphic visualizations. We work closely with clients, communities, and stakeholders to understand their unique needs and aspirations, ensuring that our designs reflect their values and vision while aspiring to be pioneers in forward-thinking architectural solutions that shape the built environment to enhance the human experience and contribute to a more beautiful, harmonious world.

Team

Sina
Designer / Principal
 
With a passion for fabrication and craft, Sina holds a Masters of Architecture degree from the Georgia Institute of Technology where he also served as a fabrication lab assistant and a graduate teaching assistant respectively. Having worked at companies Such as Niles Bolton Associates and Taylor Workshop, Sina’s experience and expertise spans a diverse array of project types and scales.
In his design process, Sina is dedicated to blurring the lines between theory and practice by creating spaces that evoke emotions and inspire the mind. He is passionate about pushing the boundaries of traditional concepts in creating spaces that rethink the built environment in meaningful ways.
Hamid,
Project Manager
 
With a Bachelor’s degree in Architecture and 5 years of experience in the design industry, Hamid specializes in architectural design and documentation. He has worked on notable projects such as the “Zolghadr Residence” and “Ville de Costa Rica.” Hamid is driven by the challenge of creating innovative design solutions that meet client needs while paying close attention to the details of each project.

Inspired by the way materials and structures come together, Hamid strives to create designs that are both efficient and aesthetically pleasing. He enjoys the art of transforming project descriptions into tangible solutions from scratch. One of his core principles is to consider all aspects of design simultaneously, ensuring harmony between function and aesthetics.
Hamid is passionate about designing spaces that evoke a sense of belonging and create mindful memories for those who experience them.

Dariush,
Designer / Visual Artist
 

Dariush holds a Bachelor’s degree in architecture and brings 5 years of experience to the design industry. His main areas of expertise are modeling and visualization, and he has contributed to notable projects such as “Mount Paran” and “Riverstone Shoals.”
Dariush is inspired by the functionality and simplicity in design, and he enjoys incorporating cutting-edge technology into his work. He thrives on the lifestyle of being a designer and takes pride in helping to realize a design from concept to completion.
Passionate about the simplicity of forms and feasible fabrication solutions, Dariush is dedicated to creating designs that are both practical and innovative.

Reza,
IT and Network
 

Reza is the versatile tech powerhouse behind our website.
Seamlessly integrating his +10 years of software development expertise with our architectural vision.
As a seasoned full-stack developer, Reza manages all our IT needs. He ensures our projects are showcased with cutting-edge functionality and design.
His commitment to excellence and innovation makes him the ideal collaborator.
